svg.text: PLAN 3, WEST HALF: The Clearing (the pilot) + the climb to the Top
north is up · one plot = 12 x 12 squares = 42 m
fire lookout · level, a board fits
THE DRY BED, 2 squares (the fast way down)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today: no new rule.
Plot lines: yellow = The Clearing, blue = Dead Man's Cave, red dashes = a new plot (11). Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's height. Nothing is built yet.
